# Broadcast vendor protocol fixtures

These sanitized reference captures preserve only the documented scene-discovery and scene-change envelope shapes needed by the read-only clients. They contain no tokens, machine paths, account data, source names, or media metadata.

When Meld Studio or Streamlabs Desktop is installed, run the Wizard's **Test direct** control first. A future real-build refresh may replace these fixtures only after removing credentials and unrelated broadcast metadata.
